trial_type.Description: Kind of stimulus presented in the trial.

stim_id.Description: Identifier of the presented stimulus, of the form stim-<label>. It resolves to the stimulus files, metadata and annotations with that label under the /stimuli directory.

stim_file.Description: Path of the presented stimulus file relative to the /stimuli directory. Kept alongside stim_id to show that the legacy column and the BEP044 identifier can coexist.
